cohorts.name: Cohort 1: AI Enablers & Silicon
cohorts.narrative: Subject to the semiconductor bullwhip effect. Highly vulnerable to cancellation of forward GPU purchase orders.

cohorts.name: Cohort 2: Hyperscalers & Mega-Cap Tech
cohorts.narrative: Faces margin compression from depreciating past hardware clusters and decelerating cloud growth.

cohorts.name: Cohort 3: Power, Utilities & Data Center REITs
cohorts.narrative: Reversion from AI compounder valuations back to traditional capital-intensive utility yield multiples.

cohorts.name: Cohort 4: Broader S&P 480 (Non-Tech/Cyclicals)
cohorts.narrative: Second-order macro drag caused by negative wealth effect, corporate IT budget freezes, and bank credit contraction.
